subtasks.objective: Surface the top 3 favourite items for returning customers in POS v2 by fetching existing favourite-item data when a customer is selected and rendering a focused favourites section in the customer/order flow.
subtasks.acceptance: When a returning customer is selected in POS v2, CustomerSelect.tsx calls the existing fav_items API, displays up to three favourite items with enough item context for cashier action, handles empty/loading/error states without blocking order entry, and the POS frontend typecheck/build passes.
